_doc: Copiado de Valeria y adaptado (O-20261119-8): sin emoji, sin reconocedor de voz, sin las etiquetas técnicas del error. Lo genera tools/importar_valeria_escoita.py; no se edita a mano.

pares.pista: Pull your tongue back and up, and keep your lips from rounding: rrr.
pares.misionAcerto: Rake the leaves! Three big sweeps across the floor, then high five.
pares.misionFallo: Mirror game: the grown-up says rrr with wide lips, the child copies watching the mirror.

pares.pista: For /l/ the tongue touches behind your teeth. For /r/ it pulls back and never touches.
pares.misionAcerto: Be a rock: freeze completely still while the grown-up counts to five.
pares.misionFallo: Take turns: grown-up says lock, child says rock, faster and faster.

pares.pista: Keep the tip of your tongue down and lift the BACK of it: k, k, k.
pares.misionAcerto: Unlock the door: pretend to turn a key three times and open an imaginary door.
pares.misionFallo: Hold a finger on the tip of the tongue (gently, on the chin) so only the back lifts: k-k-k together.

pares.pista: Hand on your throat: /b/ buzzes, /p/ is a quiet puff of air.
pares.misionAcerto: Pretend to bite a juicy peach and wipe your chin. Now the grown-up copies you.
pares.misionFallo: Puff test: hold a small piece of paper in front of your mouth — /p/ makes it move, /b/ does not.

pares.pista: Round your lips and pull the tongue back: shhh, like asking for quiet.
pares.misionAcerto: Sail the ship: rock side to side like a boat while the grown-up makes wave sounds.
pares.misionFallo: Quiet game: both of you go shhh with a finger on the lips for three seconds.

pares.pista: Start with a long ssss and slide into the n: ssss-nail.
pares.misionAcerto: Move like a snail: crawl very, very slowly to the grown-up.
pares.misionFallo: Snake first: hiss ssss together for three seconds, then add the word.

pares.pista: Finish the word with a little tap of the tongue: seat-t.
pares.misionAcerto: Musical chairs, mini version: walk around a chair and sit down when the grown-up claps.
pares.misionFallo: Tap it out: the grown-up taps the table on the final /t/ and the child copies.

pares.pista: Put the tip of your tongue gently between your teeth and blow: thhh.
pares.misionAcerto: Thin and wide: make yourself as thin as you can, then as wide as you can.
pares.misionFallo: Mirror check: both of you show your tongue between your teeth and blow softly.

pares.pista: Stretch it out and smile wide: sheeeep. The short one is quick: ship.
pares.misionAcerto: Count sheep: jump over an imaginary fence three times, baaing each jump.
pares.misionFallo: Long and short: stretch your arms wide for sheep, bring them close for ship.

fases.frase: It takes us places on four wheels.
fases.accion: Roll a toy car along the floor towards your child.

fases.frase: This round part is what turns and turns.
fases.accion: Spin the wheel with a finger and let your child stop it.

fases.frase: Hands on the wheel and off we go.
fases.accion: Hold an imaginary steering wheel and turn it left and right together.

fases.frase: Zooming along with the speed lines behind.
fases.accion: Race the toy car across the floor as quickly as you both can.

fases.frase: It lives with us and goes woof.
fases.accion: Walk a stuffed dog across the table towards your child.

fases.frase: This is the part that wags when it is happy.
fases.accion: Wag a hand behind you like a tail while your child copies.

fases.frase: Four legs going as fast as they can.
fases.accion: Run on the spot together for five seconds.

fases.frase: That is how the fur feels under your hand.
fases.accion: Stroke the stuffed dog and then your child’s cheek with the same gentle touch.

fases.frase: This is the cow.
fases.accion: Trace imaginary spots on your arm and make a soft moo together.

fases.frase: The cow swishes its long tail.
fases.accion: Swish one arm back and forth behind you like a happy tail.

fases.frase: The cow munches sweet green grass.
fases.accion: Munch with your mouth open and closed like a chewing cow.

fases.frase: The cow is very big and strong.
fases.accion: Spread both arms out wide to show how huge the cow is.

fases.frase: This is the little cat.
fases.accion: Stroke an imaginary kitten gently on your lap.

fases.frase: The cat has tickly whiskers on its face.
fases.accion: Draw three little whisker lines on your cheeks with your fingers.

fases.frase: The cat climbs up the tall tree.
fases.accion: Climb with hand-over-hand motions reaching up high.

fases.frase: The cat has very soft fur.
fases.accion: Gently stroke your cheek with the back of your hand.

fases.frase: Look at the sky, here comes the rain.
fases.accion: Wiggle your fingers moving down from the sky like falling raindrops.

fases.frase: A tiny drop of water falls on your nose.
fases.accion: Gently tap the tip of your child’s nose with one finger.

fases.frase: The raindrops fall all over the grass.
fases.accion: Tap your fingers rhythmically on the table, faster and faster.

fases.frase: Everything outside is cool and wet.
fases.accion: Shake your hands dry as if you just splashed in a puddle.

fases.frase: Here comes the chugga chugga train.
fases.accion: Pump your bent arms in circles like train wheels.

fases.frase: The train rolls along the metal track.
fases.accion: Draw two parallel lines with both index fingers on the floor.

fases.frase: The train starts to go down the line.
fases.accion: Choo-choo march around the room together.

fases.frase: The train has so many cars, it is very long.
fases.accion: Open both arms as wide as possible from side to side.

fases.frase: Look at the colorful little bird.
fases.accion: Link your thumbs and flap your hands like bird wings.

fases.frase: The bird opens its feather wing.
fases.accion: Flap your elbows up and down like little wings.

fases.frase: The bird takes off and starts to fly.
fases.accion: Soar with outstretched arms across the living room.

fases.frase: The bird flies way up in the high sky.
fases.accion: Stand on your tiptoes reaching both hands toward the ceiling.

fases.frase: Yummy toast for breakfast!
fases.accion: Pretend to butter a slice of toast in the palm of your hand.

fases.frase: The outside edge is the crunchy crust.
fases.accion: Tap your knuckles together making a crunchy sound.

fases.frase: Open wide and take a big bite.
fases.accion: Chomp your hands together like a giant bite.

fases.frase: Fresh from the toaster, it feels warm.
fases.accion: Blow warm breath onto your cupped hands.

fases.frase: Look at the red party balloon.
fases.accion: Pretend to hold a floating string in your hand.

fases.frase: Hold tight to the long string.
fases.accion: Pinch two fingers tight and pull down gently.

fases.frase: When it pokes a pin, it goes pop!
fases.accion: Clap hands together loudly on the word pop!

fases.frase: Full of air, the balloon is so round.
fases.accion: Draw a big circular ball in the air with both hands.

capsulas.montaxe: Get two teddy bears that look the same but are clearly different sizes: one clearly BIG and one clearly SMALL. Put both teddy bears in front of your child.

voltas.frase: Which teddy is the BIG one? Hand it to me and tell me!
voltas.accion: Your child hands you the big teddy; hug it wide and puff your cheeks to show how huge it is.

voltas.frase: Now the other way round: which teddy is the SMALL one?
voltas.accion: Your child hands you the small teddy; hide it in one hand and whisper the word in a tiny voice.

capsulas.montaxe: Take two identical spoons: wash one until it shines and smear the other spoon with a little food. Put them side by side.

voltas.frase: Point to the spoon with food all over it. How is this one?
voltas.accion: Your child points at it and you both pull a yuck face and push it away.

voltas.frase: And this other spoon, how is it? Look how it shines!
voltas.accion: Point at the shiny one, blow on it like you are polishing it, and high five.

capsulas.montaxe: Put a box with a lid in front of your child and place their favourite toy inside where they can see it. Close the box lid.

voltas.frase: The toy is stuck inside. What do we do to the box?
voltas.accion: Lift the lid together the moment your child says it, and cheer.

voltas.frase: Now the toy goes back to sleep in the box. What do we do to the lid?
voltas.accion: Push the lid down together and pat it twice.

capsulas.montaxe: Make a ramp by leaning a large hardcover book on a cushion and place a toy car at the bottom.

voltas.frase: The car goes up the steep hill! What does it do?
voltas.accion: Push the toy car slowly up the book ramp together.

voltas.frase: Now let go! The car zooms down the ramp!
voltas.accion: Let the car roll down fast and shout whee!

capsulas.montaxe: Fill one cup with cold water and another cup with warm water. Put both cups where your child can touch them.

voltas.frase: Touch this cup. Brrr, how does it feel?
voltas.accion: Both of you touch the cup and shiver with your shoulders up.

voltas.frase: Now touch the other cup, carefully. How does this one feel?
voltas.accion: Touch it, pull your hand back quickly and blow on your fingers together.

capsulas.montaxe: Stand next to the light switch with the light turned off, or hold a flashlight.

voltas.frase: It is dark in here. What do we do to the light?
voltas.accion: Your child flips the switch on and you both cheer.

voltas.frase: Now time for bed. What do we do to the light?
voltas.accion: Turn the light off and whisper goodnight together.

capsulas.montaxe: Prepare two identical baskets: fill one to the top with toys, and leave the other one completely empty.

voltas.frase: Which basket has toys piled all the way to the top?
voltas.accion: Lift the heavy basket together and grunt at how full it is.

voltas.frase: And look inside this other basket. There is nothing inside!
voltas.accion: Turn the empty basket upside down over your child’s head like a funny hat.

capsulas.montaxe: Place an open toy bin and three small toys on the floor outside the bin.

voltas.frase: Time to pack away the toys. Where do they go?
voltas.accion: Drop a toy into the bin on each word and clap.

voltas.frase: Time to play! What do we do with the toys?
voltas.accion: Dump the toys out gently on the rug.

escenarios.subtitulo: Wake up, wash, get dressed and eat breakfast

items.frase: First we wake up.
items.accion: Pretend to sleep under a blanket, then stretch with your child when the alarm goes "ring, ring".

items.frase: Then we wash.
items.accion: Rub your hands together as if you were soaping them.

items.frase: Next we get dressed.
items.accion: Pull a T-shirt over your child's head and cheer when they pop out.

items.frase: Last we eat breakfast.
items.accion: Pretend to drink a glass of milk together with both hands.

escenarios.subtitulo: Wash, sit, eat and clear the plate

items.frase: First we wash our hands.
items.accion: Rub your hands together as if you were soaping them.

items.frase: Then we sit at the table.
items.accion: Sit down together on two chairs, facing each other.

items.frase: Next we have our food.
items.accion: Bring an imaginary spoon to your mouths together.

items.frase: Last we clear the plate.
items.accion: Carry a plate (real or pretend) to the kitchen together.

items.frase: First we get in the bath.
items.accion: Lift one leg together as if stepping into the bath.

items.frase: Then we use the soap.
items.accion: Rub your child's arms with a pretend sponge.

items.frase: Next we rinse off.
items.accion: Let your fingers fall on your child's head like raindrops.

items.frase: Last we dry off.
items.accion: Wrap your child in a towel (or in your arms) and dry them.

items.frase: First we put on our shoes.
items.accion: Point to your child's shoes and touch them together.

items.frase: Then we go out to play.
items.accion: Walk a few steps together across the room "to the park".

items.frase: Next we go down the big one.
items.accion: Make a sliding motion together with your arms up.

items.frase: Last we go back.
items.accion: Put your hands together over your heads like a roof.

items.frase: First we put on pajamas.
items.accion: Point to your child's pajamas and touch the buttons together.

items.frase: Then we brush our teeth.
items.accion: Make a toothbrushing motion together.

items.frase: Next we read a book.
items.accion: Open your hands like a book and turn a page together.

items.frase: Last we close our eyes.
items.accion: Rest your heads on your hands and close your eyes.

categorias.subtitulo: From the everyday ones to the special treats

items.frase: Red, round and crunchy.
items.accion: Take a big crunchy pretend bite together.

items.frase: Yellow and curved, and you peel it first.
items.accion: Peel an imaginary one from the top down, together.

items.frase: Round, and it comes apart in little pieces.
items.accion: Pull apart an imaginary one and share the pieces.

items.frase: Little purple balls that grow in a bunch.
items.accion: Pick them off an imaginary bunch one by one and pop them in your mouths.

items.frase: Sweet, juicy and it drips down your chin.
items.accion: Eat an imaginary slice and wipe the juice off your chins.

categorias.subtitulo: From the ones at home to the ones at the zoo

items.frase: It wags its tail and goes woof.
items.accion: Get on all fours and bark at each other twice.

items.frase: Soft, with whiskers, and it goes meow.
items.accion: Stroke each other’s arm like petting fur and purr together.

items.frase: It has feathers and flies away.
items.accion: Flap your arms like wings and fly across the room together.

items.frase: Big, with a long mane, and you can ride it.
items.accion: Gallop around the room slapping your thighs for hooves.

items.frase: Black and white stripes all over.
items.accion: Draw stripes down each other’s arms with a finger.

categorias.subtitulo: What we put on to go outside

items.frase: It goes on your foot before we go out.
items.accion: Put one on together and pull the strap tight.

items.frase: It goes right on top of your head.
items.accion: Pop it on each other’s head and pull the brim down.

items.frase: It goes on before the shoe.
items.accion: Pull one onto your child’s foot while they say it, then swap.

items.frase: We zip it up when it gets cold.
items.accion: Zip an imaginary one all the way up to the chin, both of you.

items.frase: It wraps around and around your neck.
items.accion: Wind it around each other’s neck twice and tuck the ends in.

categorias.subtitulo: From the first ones children name to the trickier ones

items.frase: The color of a fire truck.
items.accion: Race to touch something of that color in the room before your child does.

items.frase: The color of the sky on a clear day.
items.accion: Point up at the sky together, then find something the same color indoors.

items.frase: The color of grass and leaves.
items.accion: Wiggle your fingers like grass growing and find something that color.

items.frase: The color of the sun and a banana.
items.accion: Make a big sun shape with your arms over your heads together.

items.frase: The color of grapes and eggplants.
items.accion: Hunt around the room for that color and clap when one of you finds it.

categorias.subtitulo: The parts children point to first

items.frase: Five fingers, and we wave with it.
items.accion: Press your palms together and count the fingers out loud.

items.frase: Right in the middle of your face, for smelling.
items.accion: Boop each other’s nose and make a beeping sound.

items.frase: It goes inside the shoe.
items.accion: Stand sole to sole and compare whose is bigger.

items.frase: It rumbles when you are hungry.
items.accion: Rub your bellies in circles and make a rumbling noise together.

items.frase: It is where your arm joins the rest of you.
items.accion: Shrug them up to your ears and drop them down, three times each.
